encode_bboxes_to_deltas: encode bounding boxes into delta coordinates using DeltaXYWHBBoxCoder for object detection regression targets
decode_deltas_to_bboxes: decode delta coordinates back to bounding boxes using DeltaXYWHBBoxCoder with optional border clipping
bbox2delta_function: compute delta transformation from proposal boxes to ground truth boxes with mean and std normalization
delta2bbox_function: apply delta offsets to anchor boxes to produce predicted bounding boxes with aspect ratio clipping
delta2bbox_glip_function: decode deltas to bounding boxes using GLIP-specific calculations with adjusted center and width height offsets
